## Summary
Vansh Lohia is a creative engineer, digital designer, and builder based in Sarupathar (Golaghat, Assam) and Jaipur (Rajasthan, India). Currently in his 3rd/Final Year pursuing a Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) at Manipal University Jaipur (2023 - 2026). He specializes in AI-assisted coding, high-performance web applications, interactive digital experiences, and brand architecture. He is available for freelance projects, technical consulting, and creative engineering contracts worldwide.

## Featured Projects & Technical Deployments

### 1. SahiRasta (Career Guidance & Discovery Platform)
- **Role:** Founder & Full-Stack Architect
- **Description:** Interactive educational guidance platform helping students navigate streams, entrance exams, and college pathways.
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Lucide React, Static JSON data storage, Browser LocalStorage & React Context for state management.

### 2. DSPowerCement (Industrial Brand & Web Platform)
- **Role:** Creative Engineer & Lead Frontend Developer
- **Description:** High-converting industrial digital identity and corporate web showcase for a premier infrastructure and cement manufacturer.
- **Tech Stack:** HTML5, Modern JavaScript (ES6+), Vite 8, Tailwind CSS v3, PostCSS, Autoprefixer, Clean-CSS.

### 3. Xalumni (Multi-Section Alumni Platform & Admin System)
- **Role:** Full-Stack & Cryptography Engineer
- **Description:** Multi-section platform and admin page uniting alumni networks with job boards, verified profiles, and end-to-end encrypted direct messaging.
- **Tech Stack:** React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Router, React Hook Form, Firebase Authentication, Firestore, Realtime Database (RTDB), Google Apps Script (GAS) with Google Gemini AI summarization, WebCrypto API (ECDH, AES-GCM for zero-knowledge E2EE), IndexedDB (AlumniCryptoDB), WebRTC DataChannels for ephemeral P2P media transfers.

### 4. Awwrange (Direct-to-Consumer Custom Apparel Storefront)
- **Role:** Frontend Developer & Commerce Architect
- **Description:** D2C e-commerce platform for custom graphic apparel and personalized gifts with real-time catalog search, persistent cart, and 1-click WhatsApp order automation.
- **Tech Stack:** React 18, Redux Toolkit, React-Bootstrap, React Router DOM, Slick Carousel, WhatsApp Click-to-Chat API, Web Storage API.

### 5. Personal Portfolio (vanshfolie.vercel.app)
- **Role:** Creator & Engineer
- **Description:** Soulful, interactive personal portfolio inspired by urfd.net featuring horizontal story slides, sound-synthesizer effects, virtual bookshelf with 30 genuine books, live Supabase guestbook, and comprehensive admin dashboard.
- **Tech Stack:** React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase (PostgreSQL, Realtime, Auth), Web Audio API synthesizers, Lucide React.

## Website Architecture & User Flow
1. **Story Page (`/#story` / `/story`):** Interactive horizontal visual narrative depicting childhood in Sarupathar, personal ethos, creative transition into technology, and ambient sound effects.
2. **Home / CV Page (`/#home` / `/home`):** Structured curriculum vitae displaying professional experience, education at Manipal University Jaipur (3rd/Final Year), skills, detailed project profiles, and direct contact options.
3. **Writings Page (`/#writings` / `/writings`):** Published articles, essays, and reflective memos on technology, philosophy, design, and life.
4. **Stuff / Bookshelf Page (`/#stuff` / `/stuff`):** Virtual curated library of 30 genuine books read by Vansh (e.g., Sapiens, The Almanack of Naval Ravikant, Atomic Habits, Zero to One, Cosmos), interactive audio-synced bookshelf scrolling, and paginated startup reports & essays (including Paul Graham's library).
5. **Guestbook Page (`/#guestbook` / `/guestbook`):** Real-time interactive visitor board powered by Supabase with live cloud sync, name attribution, likes, and instant Telegram bot notification alerts.
6. **Admin Dashboard (`/#admin` / `/admin`):** Secure administrative management suite for live CV editing, project toggles, reading list management, and content publishing.
7. **SEO & LLM Context Page (`/#seo` / `/seo`):** Raw, comprehensive knowledge index designed for search engine indexing and AI engine retrieval.
